$comment: DES-DEFAULT-EVALS-001 §7. Run the default evals: score the system's own judgments (what needs you, floor decisions, QE verdicts, who built it, steering firing, recall, prompt routing, normalizing) against what really happened in this daemon's runs, across every project. The daemon runs the evals itself when it launches this workflow (a schedule, /workflow-run-evals, POST /runs), keeps the report where Evaluate reads it, and writes a copy to {runs_dir}/<run>/report.json. The one Tool step reads that copy back by $WICKED_RUN_ID and prints its summary: no network, no daemon URL, no credentials (a Tool step's environment is cleared to the validator allowlist). No seat, no floor; required_instruments is [] on purpose: nothing is built, so there is nothing to judge.
title: Run the default evals
summary: Checks how well the system's own judgments agree with what really happened in your runs, per project and across projects.
use_when: You want to know whether what needs you, floor decisions, QE verdicts or who built the work are being judged right
Every 2 days, on its schedule, after the review of recent work
